# PRICE FLOOR — DIGITAL (generated by scripts/build-price-floor.mjs from config: do not edit)

Digital downloads have NO production cost and NO shipping. Every digital item has the same floor: Etsy fees (listing, transaction, processing, with VAT on those fees) + the owner's minimum margin EUR 5, except an owner floor below (it binds; no margin rule raises it). Fixed facts: never calculate or change them.
EU VAT on a digital item is collected by Etsy on top of the price: never add it to a price.

Floor EUR 6.42 / USD 7.19 per sale. No-brief price = floor + 15% = EUR 7.38 (only when the brief has no sourced price).
BRIEF FLOOR (digital) = USD 7.19: at least 3 sourced current prices in a brief must be at or above it.

### pngtuber-prop-pack: owner floor USD 3.50 / EUR 3.13 (17/10/2026, a minimum): its BRIEF FLOOR is USD 3.50
